sections.content: This appendix serves as a quick reference for key terms and materials used in Star Wars: Shadows of The Mandalorian War. It is designed to be helpful for players and Game Masters who download this handbook as a digital document.

content: **Active Defense:** A Dodge, Parry, or Block roll made to avoid an incoming attack.
**Attributes (ST, DX, IQ, HT):** A character’s four primary statistics: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Health.
**CP (Character Points):** Points used to build a character, buy skills, and acquire advantages.
**DR (Damage Resistance):** Protection provided by armor or natural toughness, subtracted from incoming damage.
**EP (Endurance Points):** A character’s physical stamina and energy for strenuous actions, physical exertions, and certain combat maneuvers. (Formerly “Fatigue Points” in standard GURPS).
**FP (Force Points):** A dedicated resource used exclusively for activating and sustaining Force powers.
**Force Sensitive:** An advantage required to learn and use Force powers.
**GM (Game Master):** The person who runs the game, describes the world, plays non-player characters, and interprets the rules.
**HP (Hit Points):** A character’s ability to withstand physical injury.
**Lightsaber Forms:** Specialized combat styles for Lightsaber Combat, each with unique effects, bought with CP (Forms have no FP or EP cost -- Chapter 9).
**Quick Contest:** A roll-under contest between two opposing skills or attributes.
**Roll-Under:** The core GURPS mechanic where you roll 3d6 and try to get a result equal to or less than your target number.
**Skill Level:** Your proficiency in a skill, derived from its controlling attribute and points invested.
**TL (Tech Level):** A measure of technological advancement. Most of the Old Republic era is roughly TL 8-9 (Space TL).

**How to read this:** Your native tongue is your one free language (written at Fluent, [0]); Basic and every other language are bought on the ladder (Chapter 3). Legends continuity, 3964 BBY. Tongues that carry a species' own name (Gand, Arkanian, Bith, Nikto, and others) are genuine dedicated languages, not placeholders.

**Native tongues (Legends, 3964 BBY):** Human — Basic (Coruscant); Mandalorian/Taung — Mando'a (Mandalore); Arkanian — Arkanian (Arkania); Aqualish — Aqualish (Ando); Bith — Bith (Clak'dor VII); Bothan — Bothese (Bothawui); Cathar — Catharese (Cathar); Cerean — Cerean (Cerea); Chagrian — Chagri (Champala); Devaronian — Devaronese (Devaron); Dowutin — Dowuta (Dowut); Duros — Durese (Duro); Feeorin — Feeorin (Odryn); Gamorrean — Gamorrese (Gamorr); Gand — Gand (Gand); Gran — Gran (Kinyen); Hutt — Huttese (Nal Hutta); Ithorian — Ithorese (Ithor); Jawa — Jawaese, plus a trade-cant (Tatooine); Kel Dor — Kel Dor (Dorin); Miraluka — Miralukese (Alpheridies); Mirialan — Mirialan (Mirial); Mon Calamari — Mon Calamari (Dac); Nautolan — Nautila (Glee Anselm); Nikto — Nikto (Kintan); Quarren — Quarrenese (Dac); Rakata — Rakatan (Lehon); Rodian — Rodese (Rodia); Selkath — Selkath (Manaan); Sith Pureblood — the ancient Sith language (Korriban); Sullustan — Sullustese (Sullust); Talz — Talzzi (Alzoc III); Togruta — Togruti (Shili); Trandoshan — Dosh (Trandosha); Twi'lek — Ryl, with a silent lekku sign-channel (Ryloth); Ugnaught — Ugnaught (Gentes); Zabrak — Zabraki (Iridonia).

**Special cases:** Wookiee — Shyriiwook (Kashyyyk); a Wookiee cannot physically produce Basic, so any Basic they know is Comprehension-only and bought at the half-ladder. Weequay — Sriluurian (Sriluur) for inter-tribal and off-world speech; within a clan they communicate by untranslatable pheromones. Echani — no named spoken tongue; the Echani converse chiefly through martial combat and body language (write it as 'the Echani tongue'). Tusken Raider — 'Tusken', near-untranslatable, learned by only a handful of outsiders. Yoda's Species (Tridactyls) — no named tongue is attested; the rare few known in this era (such as the Jedi Master Vandar Tokare) speak Basic, so Basic serves as their free native tongue.

**Era flags:** Chiss (Cheunh, Csilla) were sealed in the Unknown Regions and unknown to the Republic in this era -- allow a Chiss only as a rare, secretive outsider. Rattataki and Kaleesh existed but were galactically obscure until the late Republic. The Sith language is in active use, though the red-skinned 'Pureblood' lineage is a dwindling remnant by 3964 BBY.

sections.content: For character creation and tracking, it is recommended to use the dedicated ShadowBase website ([shadow-base.com](https://shadow-base.com/)), or a customized GURPS 4th Edition character sheet edited from the standard GURPS 4th Edition character sheet. These GURPS character sheets can often be found and printed from the Steve Jackson Games website ([sjgames.com/gurps/resources](https://sjgames.com/gurps/resources)). Ensure you use a sheet that includes sections for all primary and secondary characteristics, advantages, disadvantages, and skills. Players may wish to add custom sections for Force Points and your Force Alignment score (Chapter 8).
